about.title: About FragranceHub
about.subtitle: A quiet place to find the fragrance that feels like yours
about.storyParagraph1: FragranceHub was born from a passion for luxury fragrances and the belief that everyone deserves to find their signature scent. Founded in 2024, we set out to create a curated collection of the world's finest perfumes, making premium fragrances accessible to fragrance enthusiasts everywhere.
about.storyParagraph2: We carefully select each product in our collection, working directly with renowned brands to ensure authenticity and quality. Our team of fragrance experts tests and reviews every scent to provide you with detailed information and honest recommendations.
about.storyParagraph3: At FragranceHub, we understand that a fragrance is more than just a scent—it is a form of self-expression, a memory maker, and a way to leave a lasting impression. That is why we are committed to helping you discover the perfect fragrance that truly represents you.

values.qualityDescription: We only offer authentic, high-quality fragrances from trusted brands. Every product is carefully verified for authenticity.
values.careDescription: Your satisfaction is our priority. We provide exceptional customer service and support throughout your shopping journey.
values.expertDescription: Our team of fragrance experts is here to help you find the perfect scent. We provide detailed information and personalized recommendations.
values.globalDescription: We bring you fragrances from around the world, featuring both established luxury brands and emerging perfumers.

about.missionText: To make luxury fragrances accessible to everyone while maintaining the highest standards of quality, authenticity, and customer service. We believe that finding your signature scent should be an enjoyable and personalized experience, and we are here to guide you every step of the way.

faq.trackOrderQuestion: How do I track my order?
faq.trackOrderAnswer: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can use this number to track your package on our website or the carrier's website.
faq.returnPolicyAnswer: We accept returns within 30 days of purchase for unopened, unused products in their original packaging. Due to hygiene standards, opened bottles cannot be returned.
faq.authenticityAnswer: Yes, all our products are 100% authentic. We work directly with authorized distributors and brands to ensure authenticity.
faq.internationalShippingAnswer: Currently, we ship within the United States. International shipping options are coming soon. Please contact us for more information.
